value.rationale: The result gives a finite-amplitude recurrence barrier anchored at the nonzero-equilibrium height and an exact nonnegative defect measured by derivative energy. It applies uniformly to periodic and chaotic compact recurrent statistics, separates equilibrium-supported states from all non-equilibrium ergodic states, and provides a direct consistency check for numerical recurrence in the same model. This is not a parameter substitution, a table recomputation, or a local stability exercise.
